Welcome to Sham Marianas F.Z.C's Privacy Policy

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your privacy isn't just a checkbox it's a core part of our creative culture. Whether you're browsing, exploring, or building something epic with us, your personal information stays protected like a masterpiece in a gallery.

This privacy promise is designed for real people no boring legal fluff, just clear, honest info on how we handle your data. We only collect what's necessary, protect it fiercely, and never trade your trust.

You're here to create, connect, and grow we're here to make sure your digital journey is safe, seamless, and full of creative freedom.

Scope Your Privacy, Our Commitment

Your privacy goes beyond mere policy it's the foundation of everything we do. At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, protecting your personal information is more than a responsibility; it's a core value. We are committed to safeguarding your data with every service we offer.

This privacy policy outlines how we manage your information, not just when you're using our platform but throughout every interaction with us. If payments are processed through PayPal Braintree, they handle your data separately. From the moment you join, we prioritize the security, integrity, and confidentiality of your personal details, ensuring your trust is always respected and protected.

What Kind of Information Do We Collect?

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we gather only what truly matters details that help us deliver a smarter, smoother, and more personalized experience for you. This may include your name, email, contact number, location, preferences, IP address, business details, creative content you share with us, and how you interact with our site. If you're applying for a job with us, we may also collect your resume, cover letter, and other relevant details to understand you better.

To keep things safe and secure, we may verify identities through trusted third-party services. We also use cookies and similar tools to learn how you engage with our site helping us keep everything running seamlessly and intuitively. Your trust powers our platform, and we treat your data like we'd want ours treated with care, purpose, and transparency.

How We Gather Your Info Smart, Seamless & Secure

Your journey with us naturally leaves digital footprints and we use them to craft better experiences for you. From creating your account to joining campaigns or chatting with our support team, the information you share empowers us to serve you smarter.

Some details come straight from you; others come from how you interact with our platform. And yes, we may receive secure updates from our trusted tech partners to keep everything running smooth, fast, and future-ready. Your data goes beyond storage it fuels smoother, smarter experiences at every click.

Author Transparency & Trust

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we build creativity on a foundation of integrity. Trust is at the core of every project we create, and we ensure that it starts with the creators behind the scenes. To ensure our platform remains safe and secure, we responsibly collect and verify essential details about our authors. This not only helps us prevent fraud but also gives our clients peace of mind when they collaborate with our talented creators.

We strictly adhere to global standards, such as the EU Digital Services Act, and display verified information like the author's name, contact details, and business registration. This ensures every creator is authentic and trustworthy. If you need to get in touch with us, feel free to visit our Contact Page. Our authors go the extra mile to verify their identity through secure third-party services, adding an extra layer of security. Because for us, transparency isn't just a policy it's a promise we uphold for every member of our community.

Information We Get About You from Trusted Sources

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we take your privacy seriously and believe in full transparency. While we mainly collect information directly from you, there are occasions when we gather additional details from trusted external sources to provide you with a seamless experience:

  • Smooth Transactions: To ensure hassle-free transactions, we may collect your financial details (excluding payment card data) via secure payment providers.
  • Connected Platforms: If you link or log in through platforms like Google or Meta, we may access your profile information, always in line with your privacy settings.
  • Enhanced Insights: Through our trusted partners, we may receive extra insights such as demographic data or fraud alerts that help us deliver tailored services and improve your overall experience.
  • Rights Holder Data: If you're a rights holder, we might collect necessary permissions or releases, like a model release, when your image is featured in any of our offerings.
  • Team or Agency Info: If you're part of an organization, we may receive information from the account holder to better serve your team's needs.

Your trust and safety are our top priorities. We're committed to ensuring that you have full control over your information while enjoying a secure and seamless experience. Have questions or need assistance? Get in contact by visiting our Contact Page.

The Ways We Use Your Personal Info

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we believe your trust is everything so here's how we use the personal information you share with us:

  • Powering Your Experience: We use your information to smoothly deliver the services you've signed up for whether that's processing a transaction, granting access to downloads, or managing your account.
  • Making Our Platform Smarter: To keep things running smoothly and securely, we analyze site activity, fix issues, and improve your experience. This includes identifying fraud, maintaining performance, and developing better tools and services.
  • Staying in Touch with You: Expect updates about important changes, service improvements, and helpful support. We also respond to your queries and invite you to share your feedback through surveys and reviews.
  • Keeping Things Safe and Legit: We verify your identity (with your permission), protect against suspicious activity, and make sure everything complies with legal standards. This includes using third-party verification for secure onboarding and handling fraud alerts.
  • Building for the Future: Your insights help us create new features, better products, and personalized experiences. We may also use analytics to understand how people use our services and how we can reach the right audience through marketing.
  • Meeting Our Legal Duties: When the law requires it, we use your information to fulfill regulations whether that's verifying your ID, reporting to authorities, or defending our legal rights.

If we're unable to collect certain details, we may not be able to offer you our full range of services or fulfill our legal responsibilities. Where we ask for optional details, it's always your choice.

When Do We Share Your Info? Only When It Really Matters

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your trust means everything to us. While we aim to keep your personal information secure and private, there are a few situations where sharing it becomes essential always for the right reasons.

  • With Trusted Dream-Team Partners: From secure payment processors to verified hosting providers we work with top-tier services that help keep things fast, smooth, and professional behind the scenes.
  • For Legal & Safety Reasons: If the law calls, we answer to protect you, us, and the creative ecosystem we're building. This includes law enforcement, courts, or government requests.
  • Inside Teams & Agencies: If you're using our services as part of a team or agency, some info may be shared with the account holder just enough to keep things flowing.
  • Advisors with Purpose: Sometimes we bring in legal, financial, or compliance experts to guide us and that may require sharing limited data under strict confidentiality.
  • Big Moves & Business Changes: If we're ever part of a business deal, merger, or exciting new chapter, data may be shared with trusted parties as part of the transition.
  • To Protect Our Creative Space: If we suspect fraud, misuse, or a breach, we'll act fast to defend our users, our rights, and your safety.

We never sell your data. We don't believe in spam. We only share when it helps make your experience better, safer, and smarter. Have questions? Reach out here we're here to talk.

Where Your Data Travels And How We Keep It Safe Around the World

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your privacy is our priority no matter where you are or where we are. Since our team operates in places like the USA, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico, and beyond, your personal information may be securely transferred across borders to support and power the services you love. We only share your data with trusted partners, even if they're located in countries with different privacy rules. But here's the key we always make sure your information is treated with care, respect, and strong protection, just like it would be under your local laws. Whether it's locked down by international agreements, secured through encrypted contracts, or handled by verified data-compliant teams, we never compromise on your safety. By continuing with us, you agree to let us handle your data responsibly and globally always with your best interest at heart.

Your Privacy. Your Power

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we don't just protect your data we hand you the remote. Wherever you are in the world, if your local laws support it, you may have the following rights and we're all in to help you use them:

  • See What We See: Want to know what info we hold about you? It's your right to ask and our job to answer.
  • Fix What's Wrong: If something's outdated or off, let us know and we'll make it right.
  • Wipe the Slate Clean: Don't want us holding your data anymore? You can ask us to delete it no hard feelings.
  • Put It On Pause: Feel like taking a break? You can limit how we use your info, anytime.
  • Say "No Thanks": Don't want your info used in a certain way? You can object and we'll listen.
  • Take It With You: Do you require your data in an understandable, practical format? Just ask it's yours.
  • Not for Sale: You can choose not to have your data shared or sold for targeted advertising. Just click "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" in the footer of our site.

Before we act on a request, we might need to verify that it's really you just to be safe. In some cases, if we're legally required to keep certain data, we'll let you know why. But don't worry your rights will always come first. You can also manage your account details anytime by logging in. Want us to permanently remove everything? Just send a data deletion request it's your call. At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, protecting your privacy is our promise and your peace of mind.

Stay in the Loop Only If You Want To

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we only show up in your inbox when we have something worth your time like fresh ideas, exclusive updates, or services tailored just for you. Not feeling it? No hard feelings. One click on "unsubscribe," and we'll give you space. Your digital comfort matters, too. You decide how cookies play in your browsing experience accept them all, get notified, or block them completely. Just so you know, if you block cookies, it may affect how well our site works for you. Curious about what we track and why? Dive into the full details in our [Cookie Policy].

Cookies & Web Analytics The Digital Pulse of Your Visit

When you visit Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we don't just welcome you we listen. Our system quietly collects helpful details like your device type, browser power, what pages you explore, and how long you stick around. Why? To make every click count and every visit smoother, faster, and more tailored to your vibe. We use cookies and smart analytics to understand how you experience our site which parts you love, where you linger, and how we can keep leveling up your journey with us. It's all about delivering a browsing experience that feels intuitive and personal.

You're in control want to allow cookies, get notified when they pop up, or block them completely? You have complete control over that through your browser's settings. Just keep in mind: turning them off might make things a little less fluid. We also occasionally work with trusted ad partners to show you tailored content elsewhere online think of it as a helpful reminder, not a random interruption. And while some browsers offer "Do Not Track" signals, we currently don't act on those but rest assured, our focus is always on creating a respectful and optimized experience for you. At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, every digital detail matters because your journey deserves nothing less than seamless.

Think Before You Share

At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your privacy is a priority but the moment you decide to post publicly, it becomes your spotlight. Whether you're dropping a comment on a forum, connecting with someone on social media, or messaging another creator you're in control of what you share. Just remember: once it's out there, it's out there. If you're using a third-party platform or another website to interact, their privacy rules apply not ours. So, always take a moment to double-check their policies before handing over your personal info. Your voice matters just make sure it's protected.

How Long We Keep Your Info And How You Stay in Control

We believe in keeping things clean and clear and that includes your personal information. At Sham Marianas F.Z.C, we only hold your data for as long as it's actually needed. No hoarding. No hidden files. Just smart, purpose-driven storage. When deciding how long to keep something, we ask: Is it useful? Is it safe to keep? Are we legally required to store it?

Once it's no longer essential, we let it go. If you ever feel like breaking up with us or want to manage your personal info, just say the word. Whether you're deleting an account, fixing a detail, or just want to go off the grid we'll handle it with care. Just a heads-up: in rare cases, we might need to hold on to certain info to follow the law, solve problems, stop fraud, or respond to authorities. But rest assured, even that data stays protected and handled with full transparency. Because at Sham Marianas F.Z.C, your data isn't just stored it's respected.
